data.narrative:
Ocius Technology is a Series B-stage defense and security company founded by Robert Dane, having secured A$176M via an Australian Program of Record contract as of March 2026. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 10 peers—2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms operating in the same sector and stage.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using the $176M contract value as a base proxy and applying a typical 1.9x Series B step-up multiplier, implies a valuation of $334M. Peer-median analysis across seven same-stage, same-sector comparables—including Dream Security ($3.0B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), Castelion ($1.0B), and Defense Unicorns ($1.0B)—yields a median of $1.0B, with a range spanning $300M to $3.0B. The stage-progression method anchors the lower bound; the peer set reflects material heterogeneity typical of pre-IPO defense-tech funding.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $284M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $667M. Key uncertainties include the monetization trajectory of the government contract, conversion of program-of-record status into sustained revenue, and competitive positioning relative to the peer set's upper outliers. The wide interquartile spread reflects genuine uncertainty around stage-appropriate value in this sector.
